create_qwen2vl_image_processor: create a Qwen2VLImageProcessorPil instance with custom min_pixels, max_pixels, patch_size, temporal_patch_size, and merge_size kwargs
run_smart_resize_image: run smart_resize to rescale image height and width so dimensions are divisible by a factor and pixel count stays within min and max bounds
preprocess_qwen2vl_images: preprocess a list of PIL images by resizing, rescaling, normalizing, and producing pixel_values and image_grid_thw for Qwen2-VL model input
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches for a given height and width using smart_resize and patch/merge sizes without loading the image
build_qwen2vl_image_kwargs: build Qwen2VLImageProcessorKwargs with min_pixels, max_pixels, patch_size, temporal_patch_size, and merge_size configuration
